idea: A pencil sketch of a persimmon on a ruled notebook page turns into the 青柿文具 logo, and the brand writes out its promise by hand.
leave: This is a stationery brand for people who write by hand.
subject: the persimmon, from pencil sketch to finished mark

device.what: a ruled notebook page that everything is drawn and written on
device.why: the brand sells paper, so its story is told on its own paper

change.from: a ruled notebook page with the first stroke of a pencil circle
change.to: a full pencil outline of a fruit with a stem, soaked in a pale orange wash
the persimmon logo has landed on it and moved left, and 青柿文具 is written beside it over a short orange underline

change.from: an empty ruled page with an orange ribbon bookmark
change.to: 写字的人，值得一张好纸。 handwritten across the page and underlined in orange

text: 写字的人，值得一张好纸。

change.from: the logo alone inside an orange halo on plain paper
change.to: the logo over the name and the promise, the halo grown wider

text: 写字的人，值得一张好纸。
